Players Committee card image of [[Jakku (Dark) (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E3), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Unless your Resistance character or [Resistance] starship here, you may not draw more than one battle destiny here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/jakku_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 793bf65] (15 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
